profiles.label: Aggro
profiles.description: Cheap creatures and tricks. Most spells cost one to three.

profiles.label: Midrange
profiles.description: A smooth curve peaking at two and three with a few expensive threats.

profiles.label: Control
profiles.description: Fewer early plays, more answers, and top-end threats that win late.

profiles.label: Jumpstart packet
profiles.description: Low and tight so two packets together still curve out on eight lands each.

profiles.label: Ramp
profiles.description: Cheap mana sources early, then a second peak of big threats at five and six.
